description: Source code for a command-line utility that computes MD5 and SHA256 hashes of files or standard input, with options to include filenames and suppress newlines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, selecting hash type, and processing files or stdin.

methods.name: md5_hash
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a file stream.

methods.name: sha256_hash
methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a file stream.

methods.name: get_hash_type
methods.description: Retrieves hash function info based on hash type name.

methods.name: hash_buf
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream into a buffer.

methods.name: hash_string
methods.description: Converts hash byte array into hexadecimal string.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: MD5_end
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 hash and outputs result.

methods.name: SHA256_Final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA256 hash and outputs result.

methods.name: SHA256_Transform
methods.description: Performs SHA256 compression function on a block.
